      // second run appends a second widget.js, attaches a second set of button
      // handlers and fires a second auto-open apply — the shopper then sees the
      // same product applied twice. Namespaced like the flag set below: with two apps
      // embedded on one page a bare global would let either app's init block the other.
      if (window[tintNs('TINT_WIDGET_INITIALIZED')]) return;

      // Check if buttons exist on page or if URL has open-tint parameter
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-tint-button][data-tint-app="' + tintAppId + '"]');
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const hasOpenTintParam = urlParams.has(tintOpenParam);
      const metafieldAccessServer = "https:\/\/api.shopi.tintvto.com";
      const metafieldBackUrl = null;
      const metafieldPreviewProductIdRaw = null;
      const metafieldFeatureFlagsRaw = [];
      const normalizeFeatureFlags = (value) => {
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
          return value.map(flag => String(flag).trim()).filter(Boolean);
        }
        if (typeof value !== "string") {
          return [];
        }
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
            return parsed.map(flag => String(flag).trim()).filter(Boolean);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          return value.split(",").map(flag => flag.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        }
        return [];
      };
      const metafieldFeatureFlags = normalizeFeatureFlags(metafieldFeatureFlagsRaw);
      const normalizedBackUrl = metafieldBackUrl ? String(metafieldBackUrl).trim() : "";
      const hasBackUrlMetafield = Boolean(normalizedBackUrl && normalizedBackUrl !== "disabled");
      const normalizedPreviewProductId = metafieldPreviewProductIdRaw
        ? String(metafieldPreviewProductIdRaw).trim()
        : "";
      const shopPreviewProductId =
        normalizedPreviewProductId && normalizedPreviewProductId !== "disabled"
          ? normalizedPreviewProductId

      // Get shopify-host from first button or from product metafield if open-tint param exists
      let shopifyHost = null;
      if (buttons.length > 0) {
        shopifyHost = buttons[0].getAttribute('data-shopify-host');

        // Prefer shop metafield (works on any page), fall back to product metafield (backward compatible)
        if (metafieldAccessServer) {
          shopifyHost = metafieldAccessServer;
        } else {
          
        }
      }
      
      if (!shopifyHost) return;

      // Demo / onboarding preview (back-to-Shopify button present): fetch the showcase
      // product set from production via the /demo proxy instead of the merchant's own
      // (still empty) store, so the merchant can try the demo products right after setup.
      if (hasBackUrlMetafield) {
        const normalizedHost = String(shopifyHost).replace(/\/+$/, '');
        shopifyHost = `${normalizedHost}/demo`;
      }

      window[tintNs('TINT_WIDGET_INITIALIZED')] = true;

      // Load widget script — only a production store pulls the production
      // bundle; every non-prod store (test/UAT and dev) uses the UAT bundle so
      // we never ship an untested widget to a live storefront. shopifyHost is
      // the accessServer/API origin injected per app:
      //   api.shopi.tintvto.com  -> https://tintvto.com      (production)
      //   anything else          -> https://uat.tintvto.com  (test / UAT / dev)
      const widgetOrigin = (() => {
        let host = '';
        try {
          host = new URL(shopifyHost).hostname;
        } catch (error) {
          return 'https://tintvto.com';
        }
        return host === 'api.shopi.tintvto.com' ? 'https://tintvto.com' : 'https://uat.tintvto.com';
      })();

      const script = document.createElement('script');
      script.type = 'module';
      // The per-app bundle name comes from the `widgetScript` metafield (widget.js vs
      // widget-glasses.js), but that value is authored env-blind in the app manifest
      // (always uat.tintvto.com), so the origin above still decides the environment.
      // Taking the path from one and the origin from the other keeps both: the right
      // app's bundle, from the right environment.
      script.src = (function() {
        const configured = "https:\/\/uat.tintvto.com\/shopify\/widget.js";
        try {
          return widgetOrigin + new URL(configured).pathname;
        } catch (error) {
          return widgetOrigin + '/shopify/widget.js';
        }
      })();
      script.onerror = () => console.error('[TINT] Failed to load widget script');
      document.head.appendChild(script);

      // Wait for script and custom element to be ready
      script.onload = () => {
        customElements.whenDefined(tintWidgetTag).then(() => {
          const widget = document.getElementById('tint-vto-widget-' + tintAppId);
          if (!widget) return;

          // Set widget attributes
          // `<shopId>-<appId>` for every app but the legacy one, whose metafield holds
          // the bare id — so each app's try-ons are their own analytics series while
          // the legacy app's existing series is untouched. Consumers that key on the
          // store itself (the config CDN, the product catalogue) strip the suffix.
          // `$app` is per-app, so each app's embed reads its own value here.
          widget.setAttribute('shopify-store-id', '62958600436');
          widget.setAttribute('shopify-host', shopifyHost);
          widget.setAttribute('lang', 'en');
          const existingFeatures = widget.getAttribute('features');
          const existingFeatureList = existingFeatures ? existingFeatures.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];
          // In demo mode the products come from production, so hide cart actions that would
          // otherwise try to add non-existent products to the merchant's own store.
          const demoFeatureList = hasBackUrlMetafield ? ['go_to_cart_hidden', 'add_to_cart_hidden'] : [];
          const mergedFeatureList = [...new Set([...existingFeatureList, ...metafieldFeatureFlags, ...demoFeatureList])];
          if (mergedFeatureList.length > 0) {
            widget.setAttribute('features', mergedFeatureList.join(','));
          }

          window[tintNs('TINT_GVTO')] = widget;

          // Wait for widget API to be ready
          const attachListeners = () => {
            if (!widget.open) {
              setTimeout(attachListeners, 100);
              return;
            }

            const PALETTE_MARK = "__tint_pl__";
            const isPaletteRaw = false;
            const isPalette = isPaletteRaw === true || isPaletteRaw === "true" || isPaletteRaw === 1 || isPaletteRaw === "1";
            const normalizeId = (id) => {
              if (typeof id !== "string") return id;
              const idx = id.indexOf(PALETTE_MARK);
              return idx === -1 ? id : id.slice(0, idx);
            };

            const getSelectedVariantId = () => {
              const input =
                document.querySelector('input[name="id"]:checked') ||
                document.querySelector('input[name="id"]');
              if (!input) return null;
              const value = input.value;
              return value ? String(value) : null;
            };

            // Cart events
            widget.addEventListener("addToCart", ({ detail }) => {
              const variantIds = detail
                .map(p => p.swatches.find(s => s.active)?.sku)
                .filter(Boolean)
                .map(normalizeId);

              const addJsUrl = `${window.Shopify.routes.root}cart/add.js`;
              const addLegacyUrl = `${window.Shopify.routes.root}cart/add`;

              const tryAddLegacy = async ({ id, productId }) => {
                const fd = new FormData();
                fd.append("quantity", "1");
                fd.append("form_type", "product");
                fd.append("utf8", "✓");
                fd.append("id", String(id));
                if (productId) {
                  fd.append("product-id", String(productId));
                }

                const r = await fetch(addLegacyUrl, {
                  method: "POST",
                  body: fd,
                  credentials: "same-origin",
                  headers: { accept: "application/javascript" },
                });
                if (!r.ok) {
                  const text = await r.text().catch(() => "");
                  throw new Error(`[TINT] cart/add legacy failed: ${r.status} ${r.statusText} ${text}`);
                }
                return r;
              };

              const tryAddModern = async (ids) => {
                const r = await fetch(addJsUrl, {
                  method: "POST",
                  credentials: "same-origin",
                  headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    accept: "application/json",
                  },
                  body: JSON.stringify({
                    items: ids.map((id) => ({ id, quantity: 1 })),
                  }),
                });
                if (!r.ok) {
                  const text = await r.text().catch(() => "");
                  throw new Error(`[TINT] cart/add.js failed: ${r.status} ${r.statusText} ${text}`);
                }
                return r;
              };

              (async () => {
                try {
                  await tryAddModern(variantIds);
                } catch (error) {
                  try {
                    const productId =
                      (detail && detail[0] && (detail[0].productId || detail[0].product_id || detail[0].id)) || null;
                    for (const id of variantIds) {
                      await tryAddLegacy({ id, productId });
                    }
                  } catch (fallbackError) {
                    console.error("[TINT] Add to cart failed (modern + legacy)", {
                      error,
                      fallbackError,
                      variantIds,
                    });
                  }
                }
              })();
            });

            widget.addEventListener("redirectToCart", () => {
              widget.close();
              window.location.href = "/cart/";
            });

            widget.addEventListener("removeFromCart", ({ detail }) => {
              const variantIds = detail
                .map(p => p.swatches.find(s => s.active)?.sku)
                .filter(Boolean)
                .map(normalizeId);
              fetch(`${window.Shopify.routes.root}cart/update.js`, {
                method: "POST",
                headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  updates: variantIds.reduce((acc, id) => ({ ...acc, [id]: 0 }), {})

            // Handle widget close - redirect to backUrl query param if present
            widget.addEventListener("close", () => {
              const backUrl = urlParams.get('backUrl');
              if (backUrl) window.location.href = decodeURIComponent(backUrl);
            });

            // Attach button handlers
            buttons.forEach(button => {
              // Acne buttons are wired separately (TINT_SETUP_ACNE_BUTTONS) and
              // open the standalone acne widget — skip them here so the color
              // widget never claims them.
              if (button.getAttribute('data-widget-kind') === 'acne') return;

              const openWidget = async () => {
                const productId = button.getAttribute('data-product-id');
                try {
                  await widget.open();
                  await widget.hideBackButton()
                  await widget.useWebcam();
                  if (productId) {
                    const selectedVariantId = normalizeId(getSelectedVariantId());
                    const widgetProductId = selectedVariantId
                      ? (isPalette ? `${productId}${PALETTE_MARK}${selectedVariantId}` : productId)
                      : productId;
                    widget.shopifyApplyProduct(widgetProductId);
                  }
                } catch (error) {
                  console.error('[TINT] Widget error:', error);
                }
              };

              button.addEventListener("click", () => {
                if (DISCLAIMER_ENABLED && !isDisclaimerAccepted()) {
                  showDisclaimer(openWidget);
                } else {
                  openWidget();
                }
              });
            });

            const resolveAutoOpenProductId = () => {
              if (hasBackUrlMetafield && shopPreviewProductId) {
                return shopPreviewProductId;
              }
              if (pageProductId) {
                return pageProductId;
              }
              return shopPreviewProductId;
            };

            // Auto-open when URL has open-tint (explicit preview) OR the onboarding demo
            // backUrl metafield is set. A password-gated storefront drops the ?open-tint
            // query on the /password redirect, so the metafield is the reliable demo signal.
            if (urlParams.has(tintOpenParam) || hasBackUrlMetafield) {
              setTimeout(async () => {
                try {
                  await widget.open();
                  if(!hasBackUrlMetafield){
                    await widget.hideBackButton()
                  }
                  await widget.useWebcam();
                  const productId = resolveAutoOpenProductId();
                  if (productId) {
                    const selectedVariantId = normalizeId(getSelectedVariantId());
                    const widgetProductId = selectedVariantId
                      ? (isPalette ? `${productId}${PALETTE_MARK}${selectedVariantId}` : productId)
                      : productId;
                    widget.shopifyApplyProduct(widgetProductId);
                  }
                } catch (error) {
                  console.error('[TINT] Auto-open failed:', error);
                }
              }, 100);
            }
          };

          attachListeners();
        }).catch(error => console.error('[TINT] Custom element error:', error));
      };
    }

    // Make initializeWidget available globally so buttons can call it
    window[tintNs('TINT_INITIALIZE_WIDGET')] = initializeWidget;

    // Auto-open when ?open-tint is present, or when the onboarding demo backUrl
    // metafield is set (the latter survives the /password gate redirect that strips
    // ?open-tint, so a password-protected store still opens the step-3 demo).
    // Route to the widget the page's product actually uses: an acne product opens
    // the standalone acne widget; everything else opens the color/makeup widget.
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const demoBackUrlRaw = null;
    const normalizedDemoBackUrl = demoBackUrlRaw ? String(demoBackUrlRaw).trim() : "";
    const hasDemoBackUrl = Boolean(normalizedDemoBackUrl && normalizedDemoBackUrl !== "disabled");
    const shouldAutoInit = (urlParams.has(tintOpenParam) || hasDemoBackUrl) && !isShopifyDesignMode;
    if (shouldAutoInit) {
      const findAcneButton = () =>
        document.querySelector('[data-tint-button][data-widget-kind="acne"]');
      const autoOpen = () => {
        if (findAcneButton()) {
          // The acne embed script (below) exposes the opener; it may define

          if (window.TINT_OPEN_ACNE_AUTO) {
            window.TINT_OPEN_ACNE_AUTO(findAcneButton());
          } else {
            setTimeout(autoOpen, 50);
          }
          return;
        }
        initializeWidget();
      };
      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', autoOpen);
      } else {
        autoOpen();
      }
    }
  })();

<script>
  (function() {
    // Never run inside the theme customizer.
    if (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.designMode) return;
    if (window.TINT_ACNE_INITIALIZED) return;
    window.TINT_ACNE_INITIALIZED = true;

    // Which acne bundle to load is decided by the store's accessServer, the same
    // signal the color widget maps above:
    //   api.shopi.tintvto.com  -> https://tintvto.com/acne      (production)
    //   anything else          -> https://dev.tintvto.com/acne  (test / UAT / dev)
    // Only an explicit production accessServer pulls the production bundle; a button
    // with no host, or an unparseable one, stays on dev rather than guessing prod.
    // (The color widget sends non-prod stores to UAT; acne is QA'd on dev, so its
    // non-prod arm points there instead.)
    const ACNE_PROD_SCRIPT_SRC = 'https://tintvto.com/acne/widget.js';
    const ACNE_NON_PROD_SCRIPT_SRC = 'https://dev.tintvto.com/acne/widget.js';
    const ACNE_TAG = 'tintvto-acne';
    const SHOP_ID = '62958600436';
    const LANG = 'en';

    function acneScriptSrc(shopifyHost) {
      let host = '';
      try {
        host = new URL(shopifyHost).hostname;
      } catch (error) {
        return ACNE_NON_PROD_SCRIPT_SRC;
      }
      return host === 'api.shopi.tintvto.com' ? ACNE_PROD_SCRIPT_SRC : ACNE_NON_PROD_SCRIPT_SRC;
    }

    // Load the acne bundle once; resolves when <tintvto-acne> is defined. The origin
    // is fixed by the first button that opens the widget — every button on a page
    // carries the same shop's accessServer, so later calls cannot disagree.
    let scriptPromise = null;
    function loadAcneWidget(shopifyHost) {
      if (scriptPromise) return scriptPromise;
      scriptPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.type = 'module';
        script.src = acneScriptSrc(shopifyHost);
        script.onload = () => customElements.whenDefined(ACNE_TAG).then(resolve, reject);
        script.onerror = () => reject(new Error('[TINT] Failed to load acne widget script'));
        document.head.appendChild(script);
      });
      return scriptPromise;
    }

    // Fixed full-screen overlay hosting the acne element. The element does NOT
    // self-overlay (its :host is width/height:100%), so the host page frames it.
    // Created once and reused; state is preserved across opens.
    let overlay = null;
    let widgetEl = null;
    let prevOverflow = '';

    function hideOverlay() {
      if (!overlay) return;
      overlay.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
    }

    function ensureOverlay() {
      if (overlay) return;

      overlay = document.createElement('div');
      overlay.id = 'tint-acne-overlay';
      Object.assign(overlay.style, {
        position: 'fixed', inset: '0', zIndex: '2147483646', display: 'none',
        alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '16px',
        background: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)', boxSizing: 'border-box',
        // Blur the storefront behind the widget so it recedes visually.
        backdropFilter: 'blur(6px)', WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(6px)',
      });
      // A fixed `inset: 0` box spans the LARGE viewport on mobile browsers, so
      // centring the widget in it pushes the bottom rows behind the retractable
      // navigation bar. --tint-vh is the actually-visible height, published by
      // the widget element itself (widget-acne lib/widget/viewport-height.ts);
      // dvh is the fallback until its script runs. Assigned after inset so it
      // wins; an unsupported value is dropped and the `inset: 0` height stands.
      overlay.style.height = 'var(--tint-vh, 100dvh)';
      overlay.style.bottom = 'auto';

      widgetEl = document.createElement(ACNE_TAG);
      Object.assign(widgetEl.style, {
        width: 'min(1140px, 100%)', height: 'min(780px, calc(100vh - 32px))',
        borderRadius: '14px', overflow: 'hidden',
        boxShadow: '0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
      });
      // Same reason: 100vh is the large viewport, so on a phone the card was
      // taller than what the shopper can see.
      widgetEl.style.height = 'min(780px, calc(var(--tint-vh, 100dvh) - 32px))';
      // Must start hidden so the element's own open() guard doesn't short-circuit.
      widgetEl.setAttribute('hidden', '');
      widgetEl.setAttribute('lang', LANG);
      widgetEl.setAttribute('shopify-store-id', SHOP_ID);

      // The element hides itself on close; also drop the backdrop. Backdrop
      // click routes through close() so the flow resets (camera off, quiz).
      widgetEl.addEventListener(ACNE_TAG + ':close', hideOverlay);
      overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target === overlay && widgetEl.close) widgetEl.close();
      });

      overlay.appendChild(widgetEl);
      document.body.appendChild(overlay);
    }

    async function openAcne(button) {
      try {
        // API link = the product's accessServer (product-service storefront base),
        // same value the color button carries. Read before the load: it also picks
        // which environment's acne bundle this storefront gets.
        const host = button && button.getAttribute('data-shopify-host');
        await loadAcneWidget(host);
        ensureOverlay();
        if (host) widgetEl.setAttribute('shopify-host', host);

        // The product this try-on was opened FOR. The acne widget keeps it out of
        // the severity filter and applies it, so the shopper sees the product they
        // clicked rather than the one recommended for their detected severity.
        // Same on both entries: the button click and the ?open-tint auto-open.
        const productId = button && button.getAttribute('data-product-id');
        if (productId) widgetEl.setAttribute('product-id', productId);
        else widgetEl.removeAttribute('product-id');

        prevOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
        overlay.style.display = 'flex';
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        widgetEl.open();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[TINT] Acne widget error:', error);
      }
    }

    // Wire every acne button once. tint-button.liquid calls this for each button
    // flagged data-widget-kind="acne"; the dataset guard keeps it idempotent.
    function setupAcneButtons() {
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-tint-button][data-widget-kind="acne"]');
      buttons.forEach((button) => {
        if (button.dataset.tintAcneBound === '1') return;
        button.dataset.tintAcneBound = '1';
        button.addEventListener('click', () => openAcne(button));
      });
    }

    window.TINT_SETUP_ACNE_BUTTONS = setupAcneButtons;

    // Auto-open entry used by the color embed script's ?open-tint routing when
    // the page's product is an acne product. Falls back to locating the button.
    window.TINT_OPEN_ACNE_AUTO = (button) => {
      const target =
        button || document.querySelector('[data-tint-button][data-widget-kind="acne"]');
      if (target) openAcne(target);
    };
  })();
</script>
